title: The Card That Named the Nut
story: The food fair required every stall to list allergens on a card. Nia had printed one for her pepper stew, then forgotten the walnut she had ground into the base. Her cousin tasted the sauce on Saturday and named the nut. Walnut had been omitted from the card. Dropping the pot would leave the stall bare, but serving the old card would break the rule and put a visitor at risk. Nia rewrote the card in large letters and moved the pot forward so the nut line was obvious. The steward noted the change and brought a printed symbol to fix beside the handwriting. Two customers thanked her and chose the rice dish instead. She kept the new card in place. A missed ingredient was a kitchen error, while hiding it would have been a breach of trust.

Rice
Milk
Honey

quiz.question: What did the steward fix beside the new handwriting?

A refund for every bowl
A second pot with no nuts
A ban on the rice dish

quiz.question: When would Nia's mistake become a breach of trust?
options: If she served the stew while hiding the walnut
If the allergen card was very small
If a cousin tasted the sauce before noon
If two customers chose the rice instead
quiz.correctAnswer: If she served the stew while hiding the walnut
quiz.explanation: A missed ingredient is called a kitchen error, while hiding it would be a breach of trust.
quiz.supportingSentence: A missed ingredient was a kitchen error, while hiding it would have been a breach of trust.

quiz.question: What does omitted mean in this passage?
options: Left out of the written list
Heated for a second time
Given away free to the steward
Written again in larger letters
quiz.correctAnswer: Left out of the written list
quiz.explanation: Walnut had been omitted from the card, meaning it was missing from the written list.
quiz.supportingSentence: Walnut had been omitted from the card.

quiz.question: Why does the writer begin with the fair's card rule?
options: To show that listing allergens was already required
To suggest the fair sold blank cards as food
To prove Nia had never cooked a stew
To explain why her cousin was in charge
quiz.correctAnswer: To show that listing allergens was already required
quiz.explanation: The opening rule shows every stall already had to list allergens, which is the standard Nia then meets.
